services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: The Brampton Academy of Martial Arts will offer a birthday party your ninja warrior will never forget. Our birthday parties are led by instructors with extensive experience. All parties are 2 hours, curriculum-based, and full of activities. These birthdays are not open play, which means our instructor will be leading the party from start to finish, keeping the kids engaged, and guiding them through their experience! Here are the birthday party basics: - 75 minutes of programmed, instructor-led athletic activities including relays, obstacles courses, and speed & agility training. - 45 minutes time slot for food and cake. - We ask that you only arrive 20 minutes prior to the party. - AMA
